title: Dashboard Daily Routine and Calendar Display
description: Verify that the dashboard displays the correct daily routine suggestions and calendar status with AI integration.

steps.description: Navigate to the Dashboard page.
Check that the daily routine suggestions correspond to the user's predefined workout plan.
Verify the calendar status displays the correct scheduled days and highlights today.
Confirm that AI-generated tips or routine adjustments are visible and pertinent.

title: Standard Workout Logging with Sets, Reps, and Weight
description: Verify users can manually log workouts including sets, reps, and weight details properly and data is saved correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to workout start page and select Standard logging mode.
Select a workout routine category (e.g., Chest).
Manually input exercise name, sets, reps, and weight.
Submit the workout log.
Verify the workout data is saved and persisted in the database accurately.
Confirm the workout summary displays correct duration and calories burned estimate.

title: AI-assisted Workout Logging and Feedback
description: Verify AI-assisted logging mode offers interactive workout assistance, logs exercises, and provides meaningful feedback post-workout.

steps.description: Navigate to workout start page and select AI-assisted logging mode.
Follow AI prompts to perform and log exercises.
Verify exercises are logged automatically with correct sets, reps, and weights.
Upon workout completion, confirm AI feedback is displayed including intensity and tips.

title: Routine Management: Create, Modify, and Retrieve Workout Routines
description: Ensure users can create new routines, modify existing ones, and retrieve all routines categorized properly.

steps.description: Open routine management interface.
Create a new workout routine with multiple exercises under a valid category.
Verify the new routine is saved correctly and appears in the routine list.
Modify an existing routine by adding and removing exercises.
Confirm modifications are persisted and reflected in routine retrieval.
Retrieve the list of routines filtered by categories like Chest, Back, Legs, Arms.
Verify that retrieved routines match the selected category and structure.

title: AI Coach Daily Tip Display and Interaction
description: Verify daily AI-generated fitness tips display correctly and interactive chat with AI coach provides personalized advice.

steps.description: Navigate to AI Coach daily tip section on the dashboard.
Verify the daily tip loads correctly and is updated each day.
Open AI Coach chat interface and submit fitness-related questions.
Confirm the AI Coach responds promptly with relevant and coherent advice.

title: User Workout History and Profile Data Accuracy
description: Verify that workout history properly reflects all logged workouts and user profile data updates and displays correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to workout history page.
Verify all past workouts show correct dates, exercises, sets, reps, and weights.
Navigate to user profile page and update personal settings and preferences.
Confirm updates are saved and accurately reflected upon page reload.

title: Workout Timer Functionality: Start, Stop, Reset
description: Verify the integrated workout timer starts, stops, pauses, and resets correctly, supporting workout pacing and rest intervals.

steps.description: Navigate to a workout session with timer available.
Start the timer.
Confirm the timer counts time accurately.
Stop/pause the timer.
Verify the timer pauses and freezes the time count.
Restart and then reset the timer.
Confirm timer returns to zero upon reset.

title: Error Handling When Retrieving Non-existent Routine
description: Verify appropriate error messages are shown when attempting to retrieve a routine that does not exist.

steps.description: Request retrieval of a routine using an invalid or non-existent routine ID.
Verify the system returns an error response with a user-friendly error message.
Confirm the UI handles the error gracefully without crashing.

title: Validation of Workout Input Data Fields
description: Ensure input fields for sets, reps, and weights accept only valid numerical values and handle invalid inputs properly.

steps.description: Attempt to input negative numbers, zero, excessively large numbers, and non-numeric characters into the sets, reps, and weight fields.
Verify inputs are rejected or sanitized and user is prompted with appropriate validation messages.
Input valid positive numeric values and submit workout log.
Confirm successful submission without validation errors.

title: Responsive UI Test on Different Devices
description: Verify the GymTracker UI maintains usability and consistency on a range of device resolutions including desktop, tablet, and mobile phones.

steps.description: Load the application on desktop screen resolution.
Confirm all UI elements display correctly and are usable.
Load the application on tablet screen resolution.
Verify layout adjusts appropriately and remains fully functional.
Load the application on mobile phone screen resolution.
Confirm the UI is responsive, all functional controls are accessible and user can execute core flows without issues.
